## Sheet

- **Player.** Dev.
- **Class, species and level.** Fighter (Champion) 3, Dwarf, Soldier background.
- **Armor Class, Hit Points and Speed.** AC 18 (chain mail and shield), 34 Hit Points, Speed 30 ft.
- **Passive Perception and save DC.** Passive Perception 13. No save DC.
- **Saving throws.** Strength +5, Constitution +5, Dexterity +1, Intelligence -1, Wisdom +1, Charisma +0.

| Str     | Dex     | Con     | Int    | Wis     | Cha     |
| ------- | ------- | ------- | ------ | ------- | ------- |
| 16 (+3) | 12 (+1) | 16 (+3) | 8 (-1) | 13 (+1) | 10 (+0) |

### Features

- **Fighting Style (Defense).** +1 AC while wearing armor.
- **Second Wind.** Bonus action, heal 1d10 + 3. Two uses, regained on a Short or Long Rest.
- **Weapon Mastery.** Longsword (Sap), handaxe (Vex) and javelin (Slow).
- **Action Surge.** One additional action, once per Short or Long Rest.
- **Tactical Mind.** Spend Second Wind to add 1d10 to a failed ability check.
- **Improved Critical.** Weapon attacks score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.
- **Remarkable Athlete.** Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks.
- **Dwarf traits.** Darkvision 120 feet, Poison resistance, Advantage on saves against Poisoned, and +1 Hit Point per level.
- **Savage Attacker.** Once per turn, roll damage dice twice and use either result.
- **Skills.** Athletics +5, Perception +3, Intimidation +2.

## Spells

Brannoch does not cast spells.

## Inventory

- Chain mail and a shield.
- Longsword, two handaxes and four javelins.
- Explorer's pack, a soldier's insignia, a bone dice set.
- 34 gold pieces and a token from his brother's boat.

## Story

> [!narration] Portrait
> You are a broad dwarf with a grey-shot beard cut short for the helmet, and a chin that has met a shield more than once. Your chain mail is patched at the shoulder with a different-coloured ring. You stand with your feet planted and your eyes on the exits. You carry a wooden token on a cord, and you touch it when you think nobody sees.

### Backstory

Brannoch served eight years in a mountain garrison and left when his sergeant retired. He came south to find his younger brother Corin, a boatman who wrote from Saltwick two years ago and then stopped. Brannoch carries the last letter and has read it until the folds are soft.

## Goals and bonds

- **Goal.** Find Corin, last seen crewing a boat that ran the back channels. See [[Reedrunner Tithe]].
- **Bond.** [[Hobb Tarrow]], who reminds him of his old sergeant and is the first person in Saltwick to hire him.
- **Fear.** Waiting behind a wall while a place floods. It comes from the stories the garrison told about [[The Drowning of Vessen]].

## Plans

- Corin is alive and works for [[Ilse Corran]] under another name. Use him as a Spotlight when the Party confronts [[The Reedrunners]].
- If the Party gives the ledger to the Harbor Council, Corin is the person in the crew who will take the blame.
